text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer, multi-clause sentences with transitions like \"Although,\" \"In addition,\" and \"Furthermore,\"","quality":"syntactic complexity","description":"Uses more varied sentence structures and clause layering to develop ideas in a more mature written style."},{"evidence":"\"therefore, it can be said that...\" and \"To emphasize further,\"","quality":"cohesive organization","description":"Connects ideas and paragraphs more smoothly with explicit discourse markers and clearer progression."},{"evidence":"\"schoolwork, homework, extracurricular\" and \"think critically, open-mindedly and collaboratively\"","quality":"academic diction","description":"Uses more formal, school-appropriate vocabulary and abstract language to express arguments."},{"evidence":"\"high blood pressure, hypertension, severe weight loss\" and \"cortisol\"","quality":"specific elaboration","description":"Supports claims with more concrete and detailed examples rather than mostly simple restatements."},{"evidence":"\"teachers are humans too\" and \"after all\"","quality":"rhetorical development","description":"Shows more deliberate persuasive shaping through emphasis and audience-aware commentary."}]}
